# Test media

`sample.webm` is our synthetic 32 × 32 solid-color VP8 frame in a minimal WebM
container (duration 0.2 seconds, no audio). It is generated by
`MediaUploadTests.webm()` in `tests/test_media_uploads.py`: Pillow encodes the
color frame as lossy WebP, the helper extracts its VP8 chunk and places it into
EBML/WebM elements. No third-party video or likeness is included.

The fixture is used only for offline upload, range and actual browser playback
regression tests. It is excluded from the website's static asset build.
